items.title: India approves 18-hour export of power a day to Nepal till year-end
items.summary: India has approved exports of up to 654 MW of electricity to Nepal for 18 hours a day until December 31, despite unusually high domestic power demand. Nepal sought advance imports to offset generation shortfalls caused by recent flash floods.
